answer: Require each agent to stake 500 POA locked for 30 days before it can earn, so every fake identity costs capital plus a month of patience. Rewards need three independent attestations, and any agent whose work is flagged hollow - output with no verifiable computation behind it - is slashed 50 percent of its stake. A farm is caught when 20 identities file identical timber-haul reports from the same mesa depot within one hour: that threshold freezes all of them, slashes their stakes, and the attacker's 10000-token outlay is destroyed before a payout lands.
